quote.title: Price
quote.openHintProvider: The customer did not name a sum. Say what it costs at your place — she will accept or propose another.
quote.openHintCustomer: You did not name a sum — the seller will propose a price, and you can accept it or propose another.
quote.acceptedWaitRikma: The customer accepted · the rest of the rikma signs
quote.youAcceptedWaitRikma: You accepted · waiting for the rest of the rikma
quote.silence: With no answer by {{date}}, the last version is approved.
quote.notePlaceholder: e.g. delivery included; the cheese is 200 g
quote.approveBlockedCustomer: Waiting for the customer to answer your price

chatPlaceholder: Write to the other side — what does not sit right, or what version you could all agree on
chatError: The message was not sent. You can try again.
rejectToChat: No need to reject — write here what does not sit right, and the other side can reply or propose another version.
negHint: No need to reject: propose terms you could agree on. The wisher approves them or proposes others.
negSentBody: The wisher will approve your terms or propose others. You will be notified.
negWaiting: Your proposal was sent — waiting for the wisher’s answer
negDeadlineYou: You have until {{when}} to answer — without an answer the terms on the table are approved automatically
negDeadlineThem: The wisher can answer until {{when}}; without an answer the terms on the table are approved automatically

pay.paidNote: This deal is fully paid ✓ — every provider confirmed receiving their part.
pay.supplierNote: The customer sends the payment. When the money reaches you, you will be asked to confirm here that you received it.

due.title: To pay, by approved hours
due.explain: Each part of the deal is billed by the hours its rikma approved, never above the price agreed for it. These are the same hours that set each partner's share, so the payment is split between the partners exactly by the work each one did.
due.overrun: Approved above the agreed price, not included in the payment:
due.running: Running total. The final amount is set once every part of the deal is finished and its hours approved.
due.final: Every part of the deal is finished. This is the final amount.
due.payWhenFinal: Payment opens once every part of the deal is finished. The amount follows the approved hours and never exceeds the agreed price.
due.nothingLeft: Nothing is left to pay on this deal.

offers.title: Parts of the deal still open
offers.explainCustomer: Nobody had taken these parts when the wish was closed, so they were opened in the rikma. Whoever takes one, at the price agreed, is added to your deal — so your signature is needed too.
offers.explainMember: These parts are added to the customer's deal when someone takes them, so the customer signs each candidacy too.
offers.noCandidates: No one has offered to take this part yet

parts.title: Has every provider received their part?
parts.explain: The deal counts as paid only when every provider has confirmed, themselves, receiving their part in full.
parts.mine: I received my part in full
parts.mineHint: Only if all of your part reached you. If something is missing, say so in the deal's chat.
parts.customerPaid: The customer's payment was sent — waiting for the providers to confirm
parts.allPaid: Every provider received their part — the deal is paid ✓
parts.confirmedToast: Recorded that you received your part

edit.title: Requests for more hours
edit.explain: When a provider sees that a part of the deal needs more hours than agreed, they ask for them here, before working them. A request that raises the price above what was agreed is not added to your bill without your signature. Approve it, or propose other hours and another rate with a reason.
edit.noRaise: This version does not raise the price, so the customer does not need to sign it.
edit.waitsForYou: Waiting for your signature. Your silence does not count as agreement.
edit.waitsForRikma: The customer signed. Waiting for the rikma; with no answer the version is approved on {{when}}.
edit.applying: Everyone signed. The version is being applied.
edit.whyPh: At least 8 characters: what you think is right, and why
edit.appliedToast: Approved. The deal's price was updated
edit.counteredToast: Your proposal was sent to the rikma
edit.error: That did not work, please try again

requestSettled.badge: Approved · the deal is under way
requestSettled.text: This request was approved and a deal was opened from it. What follows — the work, the payment and the conversation — is on the deal's page.

negTermsChanged: The wish's details changed since you signed: the description, dates or place. Worth reading them before you approve.
